rule.passage: Where the employer dismisses the employee with immediate effect without good cause, the employee is entitled to damages
rule.inference: The entitlement arises from an immediate dismissal by the employer, so the process starts by establishing it.

rule.passage: The employment relationship may be terminated at one month’s notice during the first year of service, at two months’ notice in the second to ninth years of service and at three months’ notice thereafter, all such notice to expire at the end of a calendar month.
rule.inference: Paragraph 1 fixes the notice periods by law and paragraph 2 lets them differ only by a written individual, standard or collective contract, so where the file states no such written term the statutory periods apply.
